question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: Bookings are confirmed only once the downpayment is received, and ALL downpayments are non-refundable — cancellations for any reason forfeit the downpayment, and no-shows forfeit all payments made. You may rebook once, free of a new downpayment, if you ask at least 7 days before your check-in date; the new date must be used within 6 months and any price difference is on the guest. Camp Enoki is a pool resort and stays open in the rain, so weather isn't a valid reason for a cancellation, refund, or rebooking, and there are no refunds for early check-out either.
answer_tl: Ang booking ay kina-confirm lang pagka-receive ng downpayment, at LAHAT ng downpayment ay hindi na po nire-refund — ang pag-cancel sa kahit anong dahilan ay mawawala ang downpayment, at ang no-show ay mawawala lahat ng bayad. Pwede kayong mag-rebook ng isang beses, kung sasabihin niyo at least 7 araw bago ang check-in; gagamitin within 6 months at ang price difference ay sagot ng guest. Bukas kami kahit umuulan (pool resort kami), kaya hindi valid ang panahon bilang dahilan para mag-cancel, mag-refund, o mag-rebook, at wala ring refund kung maaga ang check-out.

question: What attractions are nearby?
answer:
Camp Enoki is close to several waterfalls, viewpoints, and local eateries. Sa dulo po ng coastal road tuwing hapon ay maraming mobile vendor dahil kilala po ang dulo ng coastal road for a good spot for sunset.  

You can also schedule a visit to Nangoloan Falls.  Recommended po bisitahin ang falls tuwing June to March.
